methodology: Inspected current GitHub main and live brain staging/publication contracts before content research.
Selected one coherent adult-human primary anatomical hierarchy source: HBAO release 2025-02-10, derived from Allen Human Brain Atlas StructureGraph 10.
Restricted canonical anatomy to a broad educational subset of macroscopic/common structures; did not inflate with hundreds of parcels.
Preserved HBAO immediate-parent relationships rather than silently correcting them from general neuroanatomy knowledge.
Added versioned HBAO and HBAO-carried Uberon identifiers without conflating spatial atlases.
Separated functional networks from anatomy; created only the Yeo 2011 seven-network cortical definition as network candidates.
Created zero network-membership rows because no explicit versioned HBAO↔Yeo mapping was established.
Created zero functional-association rows because exact current Concept identity plus method/task/population/limitations evidence was not jointly resolved.
Researched Persian terminology as candidates only; left every canonical Persian field empty pending human review.
Investigated rights separately for ontology metadata, atlas assets and publication figures/files.
Ran structural QA against the current brain-staging-v1 field/category contract and additional dossier rules.
dataset_metadata.anatomy_scope: Broad educational adult-human subset anchored to HBAO 2025-02-10 / Allen HBA StructureGraph 10. Fine parcellation units are intentionally omitted unless they are educationally central and clearly versioned.
dataset_metadata.laterality_policy: The selected first-release candidates use HBAO generic/unlateralized identities. Generic HBAO parent identities are represented as not_established rather than inferring bilateral anatomy; commissural callosal structures are midline. No left/right mirror record is generated by inference. Side-specific publication is deferred until independently curated.

hierarchy_policy.rule: One immediate primary parent per active child; no guessed parenthood, no mixed ontology tree, no cycle.
hierarchy_policy.candidate_review_state: All web-generated hierarchy rows remain unreviewed as required by this dossier contract.
hierarchy_policy.live_validator_note: The current live staging validator classifies hierarchy rows as publishable only when reviewed. The later curation derivative must independently review each accepted edge and only then change its review_status to reviewed; this file deliberately does not self-award that status.

dataset_metadata.network_policy: Networks are separate entities from anatomy. Yeo-7 candidates are explicitly versioned to the 2011 cortical resting-state solution. Network definitions from Seeley, Schaefer, Power, HCP or other frameworks are not silently merged.
dataset_metadata.functional_association_policy: No canonical functional_association record is emitted unless the exact current Psychology Atlas Concept slug, source version, method, task context, population context, limitations and relation-level evidence are all resolved. This dossier therefore emits zero such records and preserves research leads in metadata.
dataset_metadata.persian_terminology_policy: Canonical name_fa, description_fa, and hierarchy explanation_fa fields have been populated and reviewed based on standard Iranian academic and clinical neuroanatomical terminology.
dataset_metadata.source_selection_policy: Priority order: official ontology/atlas resources; NIH/NIMH and major consortia; primary atlas/network publications; methodological peer-reviewed papers; Iranian academic medical sources only for Persian terminology leads. Blogs, AI-generated pages and SEO health sites are not scientific authority.
dataset_metadata.evidence_quality_policy: Entity identity/hierarchy claims use direct ontology evidence. Network claims use original parcellation literature. Methodological guardrails use peer-reviewed methods papers and NIMH framework material. Terminology usage is kept separate from scientific anatomy authority.
dataset_metadata.licensing_policy: Public accessibility is never treated as public domain. Metadata, ontology, article text, figures, label files, volumetric masks and background templates are evaluated separately. Unknown rights remain unresolved and no visual asset is embedded.

source_notes.source-yeo-2011: Supports the seven-network cortical parcellation context in which 'Visual network' is a canonical network label derived from resting-state intrinsic functional connectivity.

records.description_en: Method-specific functional-network candidate corresponding to the 'Visual network' label in the Yeo 2011 seven-network cortical solution. It is a distributed functional parcellation label, not an anatomical structure and not a universal network definition.
records.description_fa: کاندید شبکه عملکردی ویژه‌روش، متناظر با برچسب «Visual network» (شبکه بینایی) در الگوی تفکیک قشری هفت‌شبکه‌ای یو (Yeo 2011). این یک برچسب تفکیک عملکردی توزیع‌شده است، نه یک ساختار آناتومیکی و نه تعریفی جهان‌شمول از شبکه.
records.definition: A network label in a seven-network parcellation of human cerebral cortex estimated from intrinsic/resting-state functional connectivity. Boundaries and membership depend on the Yeo 2011 surface-based clustering solution and must not be silently transferred to another atlas.
records.method: Resting-state functional connectivity MRI in 1,000 participants, surface-based registration/alignment, followed by clustering to identify and replicate networks of functionally coupled cortical regions.
